title: Segmented entry
text: Separate day, month, and year segments ordered by the locale.

title: Date or date and time
text: Minute granularity adds time segments and returns an exact instant.

title: Time zone aware
text: Wall-clock times convert in the chosen time zone with explicit handling of gaps and overlaps.

title: Limits and validation
text: Minimum and maximum dates, required checks, and custom errors.

title: Form ready
text: Submits a standard value through a hidden input in native forms.
